title: Evaluating GPT- and Reasoning-based Large Language Models on Physics Olympiad Problems: Surpassing Human Performance and Implications for Educational Assessment
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking the performance of LLMs (GPT-4o and o1-preview) against human performance on physics problems. While it discusses themes of educational integrity, equity, and fairness in its assessment implications section, these are treated as consequences of the results rather than being the subject of evaluation or benchmarking themselves.
